hero.lead: A nation of 26.6 million on the Korean Peninsula, closed to most international finance, where forest covers 64% of the land and six in ten people have electricity.

capital.heading: A nation outside the capital markets.

assets.heading: Five assets no balance sheet counts.

items.name: The Forest
items.label: Of the land under forest, 2024
items.text: Standing forest that stores carbon and water, and can earn as it stands.

items.name: The Clean Grid
items.label: Of electricity from renewable sources, 2021
items.text: Six tenths of the power from rivers.

items.name: The Farmland
items.label: Of the land in agriculture, 2023
items.text: Rice and maize on a fifth of the land, much of it mountainous.

items.name: The Land
items.label: Land area, 2023
items.text: Territory to farm, power and protect.

items.name: The People
items.label: Citizens, 2025
items.text: 18.9% are under fifteen: the workforce and the market of the next generation.

coverage.gap_text: Of people in the DPRK still cook without clean fuels.
